headline: Brent Crude Slips Below $105 Amid US-Iran Peace Talk Reports
summary: Brent crude oil prices fell below $105 following reports of U.S.-Iran peace talks mediated by Qatar, although Tehran later dismissed the reports.
why: Crude oil is a vital global commodity benchmark influencing energy sector equities, transportation costs, and broader macroeconomic inflation metrics.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Reports of peace talks and easing geopolitical tensions prompted oil prices to slip below $105.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Growing momentum in diplomatic talks reduces perceived supply disruption risks in the Middle East, leading to downward pressure on crude oil benchmarks.
